tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The Soleil ground: the app canvas, the email page, the splash screen. The same in both themes; the light theme's ground is bg-0.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on night, and the one white button. The same in both themes; the light theme's text is ink-0.

tokens.name: soleil
tokens.usage: Soleil gold: the mark, active and selected states, focus, one primary action per view.

tokens.name: ink-on-soleil
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: sun-shade
tokens.usage: The shaded tone of the three-tone sun disc in the Clusters mark.

tokens.name: sun-cream
tokens.usage: The cream highlight of the sun disc and the dashes of the Clusters mark on dark.

tokens.name: sunset-glow
tokens.usage: The studio sun orb, computed in script.js (ColorPalette, hsl(25, 95%, 50%) through hslToHex), not stored as a literal. Atmosphere only: never a flat fill, text or UI.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: The ground: canvas, body, boot screen. Night in dark, the paper tone in light.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar and raised panels one step above the ground.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Toasts and inputs.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Menus and surface cards.

tokens.name: bg-4
tokens.usage: Chips and the highest quiet surface.

tokens.name: bg-hov
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows and buttons.

tokens.name: bg-act
tokens.usage: Pressed or active fill on rows and buttons.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: The faintest divider.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: The default border.

tokens.name: line-3
tokens.usage: A stronger border and disabled outlines.

tokens.name: ink-0
tokens.usage: Primary text and the strongest icons. Ink in dark, Night in light.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Resting icons and secondary text.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Quiet labels, placeholders and eyebrows. About 2.5 to 3.1:1 on the grounds, below 4.5:1: never for text people need to read; icons and decoration only (see README, Contrast).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: The faintest ink, for disabled marks only. Far below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: soleil-soft
tokens.usage: A gold tint behind the active row or the keyboard-selected menu item.

tokens.name: msg-surface
tokens.usage: The glass surface of the messages panel and of dialogs such as feedback; toasts are solid bg-2.

tokens.name: msg-surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The same surface over the canvas, more opaque so it reads over any picture.

tokens.name: msg-border
tokens.usage: The hairline around message surfaces.

tokens.name: msg-ok
tokens.usage: Success and the single green. In the light theme about 3.1:1 as text: colour the icon, keep the words ink.

tokens.name: msg-info
tokens.usage: Information and the single blue. In the light theme about 4.4:1 as text: colour the icon, keep the words ink.

tokens.name: msg-warn
tokens.usage: Warning and the single amber. In the light theme about 3.4:1 as text: colour the icon, keep the words ink.

tokens.name: ink-error
tokens.usage: A desaturated rose for error text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Counts, badges and destructive actions. Dark danger on bg-3 is 4.34:1, just below 4.5:1: use it for small text only on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The faint line of the canvas grid.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: The faint dot of the canvas grid.

tokens.name: island-line
tokens.usage: The inset hairline of a glass island.

tokens.name: email-page
tokens.usage: The email page ground.

tokens.name: email-card
tokens.usage: The email card.

tokens.name: email-card-line
tokens.usage: The hairline around the email card.

tokens.name: email-panel
tokens.usage: A panel inside an email.

tokens.name: email-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside an email.

tokens.name: email-ink-0
tokens.usage: Headings in email.

tokens.name: email-ink-1
tokens.usage: Body text in email.

tokens.name: email-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text in email, lifted for legibility.

tokens.name: email-ink-3
tokens.usage: Footer and small print in email.

tokens.name: email-btn
tokens.usage: The one white button in an email.

tokens.name: email-btn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the email button.

tokens.name: email-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar circle in email.

tokens.name: email-avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on the email avatar.

tokens.name: studio-text
tokens.usage: Warm white for the studio site wordmark, titles and links.

tokens.name: studio-nav
tokens.usage: The glass tint of the studio bottom navigation.

tokens.name: studio-glass-border
tokens.usage: The hairline around studio glass.

tokens.name: mark-line-light
tokens.usage: The lines of a mark on a light ground, such as the Clusters orbit dashes.

tokens.name: section-blue
tokens.usage: The blue of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-clay
tokens.usage: The clay of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-green
tokens.usage: The green of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-plum
tokens.usage: The plum of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-teal
tokens.usage: The teal of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-rose
tokens.usage: The rose of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-moss
tokens.usage: The moss of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: section-slate
tokens.usage: The slate of the eight data and category colours, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: A floating island: the glass of the sidebar cards.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: What floats over the canvas and has to read at once: toasts, notices and the command bar.

tokens.name: ctl-h
tokens.usage: The height of a compact control.

tokens.name: msg-avatar
tokens.usage: The avatar in messages and comments.

tokens.name: msg-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: The small avatar in dense message rows.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, chips and most small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inputs and admin buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, canvas cards and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, settings, share and upgrade panels, and document cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The setup panel and landing banners, the largest surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: A resting card.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: A toast or raised panel.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: A dialog or the highest surface.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The focus ring: a gold hairline and a soft halo.

tokens.name: soleil-glow
tokens.usage: A soft gold halo for brand moments.

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: A glass island: a hairline under it and nothing softer.

tokens.name: island-chip
tokens.usage: A chip sitting on glass.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: The lift under an opened menu.
